# Galleon Supplies

> > Galleon Supplies is a UK wholesale distributor of industrial cleaning supplies, paper products, and washroom essentials for commercial and healthcare sectors.

Galleon Supplies specializes in bulk and pallet deals for businesses, offering branded products from Kimberly Clark, Deb, Scott, and their own Galleon Essentials line. They provide next-day delivery across the UK including Brighton and surrounding areas.
